description:
We're a crew of four Computer Science students teaming up for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge.

We write code, build web apps, and train AI. But we also know how to pitch an idea—we're just as passionate about storytelling, communication, and the business side of tech.

Great tech fails if no one understands it. We balance heavy coding with clear narratives. We don't just build working prototypes; we build practical solutions that make sense in the real world.
